label: S. Ignatii Antiocheni, Episcopi et Martyris (17 October)

chants.notes: 'cum ps. 131' on the citation line is a psalm-tone plan, not a target page; the introit antiphon itself lives at p162. The GR does engrave this introit's psalm-verse tone (mode IV) at the top of p617: 'Ps. Memento, Domine, David, et omnis mansuetudinis eius. Ant. Nos autem.' Not modeled as a separate chant.

The GR prints 'AL. Qui sequitur me, 481.' on p617, but p481 holds no alleluia: this chant's antiphon is engraved at the foot of p480 and only its verse runs onto p481. The printed back-of-book index (p898) and every other citation of it in the book give 480, so target_page is 480. Deviation from the printed citation recorded here.

Sung text: 'Frumentum Christi sum, dentibus bestiarum molar, ut panis mundus inveniar.' No scripture citation printed top-right. Psalm-verse list printed below the engraving: 'Ps. 33*, 2. 6. 16. 18. 19. 20. 21. 23' -- not modeled as a separate chant.
